page_title: HOF 4-2 BAY | Hoffenheim v Bayern Munich 18/05/2024, Stats - Flashscore.com | Match

commentary.text: 90+5' That's the end of the match.
90+5' Substitution. Wout Weghorst (Hoffenheim) on for Maximilian Beier.
90+4' Bryan Zaragoza (Bayern Munich) is awarded a yellow card for his tackle. He doesn't seem to agree with the decision, but Marco Fritz ignores the protests.
90+3' The corner is swung into the six-yard box and Matthijs de Ligt (Bayern Munich) gets his head on the ball, but he is unable to keep it down and it goes miles over the bar.
90+3' Joshua Kimmich (Bayern Munich) looks like he will be the one to try and deliver a quality ball into the penalty box from the corner kick.
90' There will be a minimum of 4 min. of added time.
88' The referee Marco Fritz awards Andrej Kramaric (Hoffenheim) a yellow card.
87' 4 - 2 Andrej Kramaric (Hoffenheim) has acres of space after latching on to a precise pass into the box. He doesn't hesitate to release a low effort which ends up in the bottom right corner.
85' 3 - 2 Andrej Kramaric (Hoffenheim) takes a great first touch to control a killer pass on the edge of the box and drills a shot into the bottom left corner in trademark fashion.
83' Hoffenheim take a short corner instead of sending the ball into the penalty area.
81' Pellegrino Matarazzo has decided to make a change. Tom Bischof (Hoffenheim) replaces Anton Stach.
81' Bryan Zaragoza (Bayern Munich) joins the action as a substitute, replacing Mathys Tel.

80' That's unlucky! Thomas Muller (Bayern Munich) side steps a tackle after receiving a pass, advances then hits a booming shot from mid-range which only rises at the last second to fly just over the bar.
78' Lovro Zvonarek (Bayern Munich) is penalised for a foul. Marco Fritz had a clear view and blows his whistle.
76' Ihlas Bebou (Hoffenheim) plays a through ball but overhits it.
73' David Jurasek (Hoffenheim) finds his way to a rebound on the edge of the box, shoots to the right side of the goal, but the keeper dives and denies him.
73' A fantastic block by a defender means that the corner from Hoffenheim comes to nothing.
72' Mathys Tel (Bayern Munich) makes an overly-aggressive challenge and Marco Fritz blows his whistle for a foul.
68' 2 - 2 It's 2:2! Ihlas Bebou feeds Andrej Kramaric (Hoffenheim) inside the box, who is unmarked and buries the ball in the right side of the net.
67' Maximilian Beier (Hoffenheim) makes a yard for himself on the edge of the box and produces a poor effort that sails miles wide of the right post.

65' Andrej Kramaric (Hoffenheim) takes a great touch after receiving a pass on the edge of the box. He immediately steers his shot towards the top left corner. Despite the precise effort, the keeper makes a diving save!
64' David Jurasek (Hoffenheim) put a cross into the box which wasn't a bad decision, but he failed to achieve what he wanted as none of his teammates managed to meet it.
62' Marco Fritz blows his whistle. Andrej Kramaric (Hoffenheim) commits a foul after dangerous play.
61' The referee stops play so that a substitution can be made and Marius Bulter trots off the pitch and is replaced by David Jurasek (Hoffenheim).
61' Pellegrino Matarazzo has decided to introduce fresh legs, with Umut Tohumcu (Hoffenheim) replacing Grischa Promel.
61' Thomas Muller (Bayern Munich) controls a square pass, he moves forward then unleashes a wild shot from mid-range which goes so far wide it nearly hits the corner flag.
57' Andrej Kramaric (Hoffenheim) decides to take a short corner instead of crossing into the box.

56' Marius Bulter (Hoffenheim) attempts to find the head of one of his teammates with a promising cross into the box, but a defender outjumps the attackers and averts the threat. The linesman points to the corner flag, Hoffenheim are going to take it.
56' Ihlas Bebou (Hoffenheim) sees an unmarked teammate and attempts to send him a low pass. However, one of the defenders reads the game perfectly and averts the danger.
55' Joshua Kimmich (Bayern Munich) unleashes a shot from a mid-range free kick that goes high over the bar. High, wide and not at all pretty.
54' Marco Fritz shows a yellow card to Florian Grillitsch (Hoffenheim) for a tough tackle.
54' Joshua Kimmich (Bayern Munich) works the corner short.
53' Alphonso Davies (Bayern Munich) tries his luck from the edge of the box after a brilliant solo effort, but it is well blocked by the defender. Bayern Munich earn a corner.
51' Grischa Promel (Hoffenheim) picks up a yellow card.
51' The referee blows his whistle as Ozan Kabak (Hoffenheim) was too aggressive in his challenge.
49' Florian Grillitsch (Hoffenheim) is penalised for holding. Marco Fritz signals a set piece.
49' Maximilian Beier (Hoffenheim) receives a precise pass on the edge of the box and releases a promising effort. Unfortunately for him, his strike flies painfully close to the right post.
48' Alphonso Davies (Bayern Munich) skips past his man but can't keep the ball in play.
46' The game restarts for the second half.
45+4' The referee blows his whistle for half-time, bringing to a close the first 45 minutes of the match.
45+3' Andrej Kramaric (Hoffenheim) decided to shoot after receiving a sweet pass. The ball went low to the middle of the goal, but Manuel Neuer made a easy save.
45+2' The resulting corner from Joshua Kimmich (Bayern Munich) is cleared by the defence.

45+2' Alphonso Davies (Bayern Munich) produces a lovely chip pass into the box, but one of the opposition players cuts it out. The referee and one of his assistants signal for a corner kick to Bayern Munich.
45' 3 min. of stoppage-time to be played.
45' Marco Fritz blows his whistle and signals a foul after Leon Goretzka (Bayern Munich) brought his opponent down.
43' The foul by Dayot Upamecano (Bayern Munich) was seen by Marco Fritz who didn't hesitate to blow the whistle.
43' The ball is out of play and the linesman points at the corner flag. Corner to Bayern Munich.
42' A defender unwittingly blocks the ball on the line after a snap shot from Thomas Muller (Bayern Munich) inside the box following a slide rule pass.
39' Thomas Muller (Bayern Munich) is offside and the linesman raises his flag.
38' Konrad Laimer (Bayern Munich) is able to continue to play.
37' Konrad Laimer (Bayern Munich) picks up an injury.
36' Marco Fritz blows his whistle and it's Andrej Kramaric (Hoffenheim) who is penalised for an offensive foul. Good decision by the referee.
34' Aleksandar Pavlovic (Bayern Munich) is writhing in pain and can now receive medical treatment after the referee signals for the physio to come onto the pitch.
34' Thomas Tuchel is forced to make a change. Aleksandar Pavlovic is not able to carry on due to injury. He is replaced by Lovro Zvonarek (Bayern Munich).
33' Ihlas Bebou (Hoffenheim) sends a rebound goalwards, low to the middle of the target, but the goalkeeper is there to stop it.

30' Maximilian Beier (Hoffenheim) connects with a cross on the edge of the box, controls the ball and pulls the trigger. Manuel Neuer makes a beautiful save to deny his effort which would have ended in the bottom right corner.
29' Andrej Kramaric (Hoffenheim) takes the corner but only sends it into a huddle of the defenders and one of them makes a good clearance.

28' Andrej Kramaric (Hoffenheim) swings in a dangerous cross from the resulting corner kick, but none of his teammates manage to outjump the defence. The ball is out of play and Hoffenheim manage to earn a corner.
28' Andrej Kramaric (Hoffenheim) sends a cross into the box, but the opposition's defence quickly intercepts the ball. The ball goes out of play. Hoffenheim are awarded a corner kick.
27' Joshua Kimmich (Bayern Munich) sends a teasing cross into the area, but Oliver Baumann intercepts the ball.
24' Marius Bulter beats an opponent and whips a cross into the box towards Pavel Kaderabek (Hoffenheim), who smashes a first-time shot high over the bar.
23' Dayot Upamecano (Bayern Munich) brings his opponent down. Marco Fritz has a clear sight of it and blows his whistle for a foul.
20' Thomas Muller (Bayern Munich) is adjudged offside.
19' Alphonso Davies (Bayern Munich) looks to break free, but an opposing player clears the ball away.
18' Andrej Kramaric (Hoffenheim) receives a good pass just outside the box, unleashes a strike from a promising position, but the shot is blocked by the defender.

18' Konrad Laimer (Bayern Munich) fashions a shot from the edge of the box after receiving an accurate pass. Oliver Baumann makes a stunning save to stop the effort from flying into the bottom right corner.
17' Marius Bulter (Hoffenheim) receives a good pass and from just outside the box he unleashes a promising strike, but the shot is blocked by the defender.
16' Hoffenheim failed to take advantage of the corner as the opposition's defence was alert and averted the threat.
15' Pavel Kaderabek (Hoffenheim) sends over a cross from the side into the penalty area in order to find one of his teammates, but he fails and the opportunity goes begging.
14' Leon Goretzka (Bayern Munich) times his run too early and the linesman raises his flag for offside.
13' Joshua Kimmich (Bayern Munich) takes a short corner kick.
12' A cross into the box from Joshua Kimmich (Bayern Munich) is cleared. Bayern Munich win a corner.
11' Konrad Laimer (Bayern Munich) produces a dangerous low pass into the penalty area, but the defence manage to cut it out.
8' 1 - 2 Goal! Maximilian Beier (Hoffenheim) takes a short pass from Andrej Kramaric in his stride in the box, jinks inside his man and unleashes an unstoppable shot into the roof of the net. 1:2.
6' 0 - 2 Alphonso Davies (Bayern Munich) collects a sweet pass and fires a low shot into the bottom right corner, leaving the keeper helpless.

4' 0 - 1 It's a goal! Mathys Tel (Bayern Munich) makes it 0:1. He jumped highest to connect with a perfect cross from Thomas Muller and planted his close-range header into the bottom left corner. Oliver Baumann was helpless.

2' Oliver Baumann was forced into action to thwart Mathys Tel (Bayern Munich). He found himself some space after latching on to a pass and unleashed a shot to the bottom left corner but couldn't beat the keeper.
1' Today's match has just started, enjoy the game!
The players are out and the match is about to start. Bayern Munich will have the kick-off.
Marco Fritz was nominated as the referee for this game.
